scope: Eight selected primary-source entries focused on task conditioning and evaluation, not an exhaustive task-to-world review. New targeted reading: Scene2Demo,STABLE,RoomWright,SceneTeract. Reused independent prior audits: SceneSmith,SceneCode,RoboCasa365,GRUtopia.
task_contract: Fixed observed room shell and openings + exact furniture text inventory, sizes/poses unknown -> RoomGenBench assets/assembly -> navigation or manipulation task evaluation. Both downstream layers matter; aesthetics is auxiliary.
execution_boundary: Only paper/project text, GitHub metadata/recursive trees and selected tiny source files inspected. No model,assets,simulator,policy,VLMjudge,training orpaidAPI executed. No business source modified.

name_checks.Task2Scene: Exact-name queries did not establish a relevant primary robot/room generation paper or official repository. Do not invent a citation; this is a bounded search result, not proof none exists.
name_checks.Task2Room: Same: no relevant primary publication/official code established in this targeted search.
homonyms_excluded: Commercial roomwright.app is not the RoomWright paper.
Third-party STABLE reproduction spaces are not official authors code.
Anonymous/public Scene2Demo project is linked by named arXiv authors; do not mix with unrelated same-name projects.

entries.name: Scene2Demo
entries.canonical_abs_title: Scene2Demo: Self-Evolving Embodied Data Generation via Object-Action Graph
entries.html_h1: Scene2Demo: Automated Embodied Data Generation for Robot Policy Learning
entries.version_caveat: 当前摘要页题名为 Self-Evolving…，但所取 v3 HTML 的 h1 为 Automated Embodied Data Generation for Robot Policy Learning；记录两者并固定 v3，不跨版本混用。
entries.role: 单张 RGB 场景重建，再生成任务配置、动作与训练数据；不是纯任务输入的新房间布局生成。

conditioning.scene_input: §3.1 由 RGB 图像 X0 重建 S0，即 S0 ~ p(S | X0)。
conditioning.task_input: 用户 query 条件化 object-action graph、BDDL 任务配置、动作序列及后续修正；没有证据说明任务驱动重设计固定房间布局。
conditioning.geometry_information: 先重建/检索可交互资产；机器人统一缩放至 0.7，操纵物会按夹爪调整尺寸，不是不可变几何协议。

evaluation.actual_rollouts: §4.1：34 张生成 RGB 图 × 3 资产变体 = 102 primitive pairs；Open/Close 24/36，Pick/Place 49/66，总计 73/102 = 71.6%。
evaluation.long_horizon: 4 类长程任务。附录 B.4 明确每类只有 1 个固定 scene-task episode，重复 10 或 20 次 demos；不能称为 10/20 个独立房间。完整成功要求全部子任务完成。
evaluation.downstream_learning: §4.5：每个 BC policy 用 100 demonstrations 训练；Open Refrigerator 24/25，Pick Up Glass 23/25。是两个合成任务上的学习效用，不是实机迁移或跨房间泛化。
evaluation.success_definition: BDDL 风格目标谓词及长程任务全部子任务完成；SR 对全部 rollout 平均。
evaluation.confounds: 各原生 baseline 的动作/修正预算及 episode 数不同；机器人和物体缩放会改变可解性，不能将这些任务提升全部归于布局。

official_code.status: 作者项目可访问，但所取页面没有 GitHub 代码链接；未建立官方实现、权重或 evaluator commit。

entries.fastfill_gap: 需将图像重建改为观测空壳与精确 IDs，固定资产/机器人缩放和任务定义，再配对相同 controller、seed 与预算。可作下游数据效用近邻，不能直接作为同协议布局基线。

entries.name: STABLE
entries.title: STABLE: Simulation-Ready Tabletop Layout Generation via a Semantics–Physics Dual System
entries.role: 真实以任务指令为输入的 tabletop layout 生成。

conditioning.input: 任务指令 + 桌面尺寸；共同预测物体位置、yaw、尺寸、描述，再检索资产。
conditioning.method: 微调 Semantic Reasoner 与 geometry-aware flow Physics Corrector；从任务关键物体逐步补入背景物体，PC 只改 pose。
conditioning.inventory: 会生成和扩展物体集合，而非原生接收完整不可变 IDs；对象是桌面，不是有门窗的房间。

evaluation.main: §4.1：以 MesaTask-10K 训练。FID/GPT-score；AwT 为必需任务物体召回，AwS 为关系匹配，OC 为 mesh 碰撞对数/全部无序对。均不等于执行操作 SR。
evaluation.rearrangement: §4.4/附录 B.3：500 个扰动场景，translation/yaw 高斯噪声 std=0.1，测 Distance Moved、EMD to GT、OC；是几何恢复，不是机器人执行重排。
evaluation.affordance_detection: 附录 E：50 个复杂场景，ManipVQA 检测 kettle/fork handle 的可抓区域 bbox；这是感知迁移检查，不是实际抓取或 BC 训练。
evaluation.not_found: 所读原文未建立 robot rollout SR 或 robot policy 训练迁移。主生成测试 N 未独立明确，不套用 500 个重排样本。
evaluation.limitations: yaw-only、固定三阶段、仅桌面；完整 6D、关节状态与多支撑面留作未来工作。

official_code.status: 作者项目 Code 文本没有实际仓库链接；Robot Operation Video 是空占位。所查作者页只链接 paper/project，未建立官方实现或 evaluation commit。

entries.fastfill_gap: 是任务语义 + 学习几何修复的直接近邻；仍需固定空壳、完整清单、多个支撑面和真实任务执行。AwT/AwS/OC 不能替代导航/操作 SR。

entries.name: RoomWright
entries.title: Beyond Placement and Articulation: Usage-Driven Code Scenes for Embodied Interaction
entries.role: 从 room brief 推断 anchor 用途并扩展场景/资产/程序，不是固定机器人任务约束下的精确清单布局。

conditioning.input: Room description 和显式 seed objects。
conditioning.task_input: 围绕 anchor 推断活动并补足 companion objects/affordances，不是给定明确 robot goal 后生成布局的同一协议。
conditioning.inventory: 方法定义 O 包含 O_seed，允许增加物体；要用于不可变清单必须关闭该扩展。
conditioning.method: Support forest、interaction graph、trigger-condition-effect 规则，生成 parts/joints/state updates，并按用途决定朝向。

evaluation.scale: 28 个 room prompts；interaction topology 统计只分析 23 个 easy/medium 场景。
evaluation.metrics: SceneEval fidelity/plausibility，加 interactive/articulated objects、复杂非铰链交互、多部件协调计数；这些计数不是执行成功率。
evaluation.robot: Isaac Sim 操作演示含 interaction manifest/runtime。所读实验未报告 episode 数、聚合任务 SR 或 policy 训练迁移。
evaluation.boundary: 可执行状态反馈比静态 mesh 更强，但不证明一般机器人任务完成。

official_code.status: 原文 HTML 未找到项目/GitHub 链接；定向题名检索未建立官方仓库。不据此断言代码不存在。

entries.fastfill_gap: 与用途驱动物体组成和因果交互资产相关。精确清单若缺少任务物件，应报 task applicability/缺失要求，不能悄悄添加。

entries.name: SceneTeract
entries.title: SceneTeract: Probing and Improving Agent-Aware Activity Reasoning in 3D Indoor Scenes
entries.role: Scene-task-agent verifier 与 VLM reasoning benchmark/reward engine；不是 scene generator。

conditioning.input: 既有 3D scene + agent profile + activity text。
conditioning.method: VLM 分解 atomic steps，几何检查导航、可达、可操作性、净空和可见性；步骤通过要求相应属性 conjunction 成立。

evaluation.scene_audit: 3,396 次 scene-task-agent verification，覆盖 Adult、Child、Wheelchair。文中 Task Success 是 verifier 判定的计划可行率，不是执行 robot policy 的 SR。
evaluation.human_validation: 100 条完整 traces：planning logical soundness 97%，overall human agreement 91%，454 个 checks 上 96.3%。
evaluation.training: GRPO 训练 VLM 预测 verifier feasibility labels；真实 ScanNet++ 上测判断准确率，不是 robot control 迁移。
evaluation.limits: 语义分解、交互区域/部件感知与几何近似均可错；不是物理执行成功证书。

official_code.verified_scope: 读取当前 README、完整 tree、verify/eval CLI 和 metrics utility；未逐行审完所有几何/物理 checker。
official_code.code_evidence: verify CLI 调用 run_pipeline；eval CLI 按 task/action/scannet 评模型预测相对几何标签。HF traces/renders 有官方链接，未下载。

entries.fastfill_gap: 最直接的 task-aware 评估适配候选，但当前数据面向 3D-FRONT；需 RoomGen mesh/ID/坐标/语义 front 映射。可作实际 rollout 前的中间 proxy，不能替代实际执行。

entries.name: SceneSmith
entries.task_is_generation_input: Yes:taskdescriptionsinducerequiredobjectandnon-goalinitialstateprompts. Not fixed user inventory or observed-shell generation.
entries.evaluation: 100generated scenes across4pick-place tasks,25each;standard16/100 vsdegraded12/100. Successagentusesfinalstate+vision;299/300labelsmanuallyagree. Actualrollout evidence,notgenerator-vs-generator task-success comparison.

official_code.verified_code_definition: Current validator maps requirements to0/0.5/1, averages them, and overall_success is average>=0.9. This is not equivalent to requiring every mandatory goal predicate true.
official_code.other_interfaces: Public scripts generate_prompts.py and policy_interface.py support task→scene prompts and goal bindings/pose targets. Their presence does not independently certify the entire paper KUKA execution pipeline or100-scene artifacts are reproducible.

official_code.verified_scope: Read current robotvalidate wrapper andsuccessscorelogic this turn: state/DMD/task inputs andmeanrequirement score>=0.9. Exporter exists in pinned complete tree; its body was not audited here.
official_code.critical_boundary: Public robot_eval utility does not upgrade the paper qualitativeMuJoCodemo to a reported quantitative task benchmark. No demo reproduction executed.

entries.name: RoboCasa365
entries.title: RoboCasa365: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework for Training and Benchmarking Generalist Robots

evaluation.scope: 365厨房任务（65 atomic、300 composite），其中220需mobile manipulation；2500 pretraining厨房由50layout×50style组成，另10个target厨房。主评测选50任务：18 atomic、16 composite-seen、16 composite-unseen。
evaluation.success: 原文AppendixG.2：每任务30trials，任务特定horizon内任何时刻满足该任务二元成功谓词即成功，随后报告跨任务平均成功率。当前官方docs为每任务随机50scenarios，不能与原文30trial协议混写。
evaluation.split_caveat: 当前1.0.1于2026-05-12把所有任务horizon增至1.5×。需固定RoboCasa/robosuite/MuJoCo版本、horizon、trial数与task/split；旧论文30trial与当前50scenario结果不直接合榜。

selected_success_code.name: NavigateKitchen
selected_success_code.definition: 目标是EnvUtils计算的fixture前机器人base目标位姿；不是家具中心或任意可见点。成功要求base平面位置距目标≤0.20m，且cos(yaw_error)≥0.98（等价约11.48°以内，角度值为推算）。

sources.read_level: 一手；选定正文/源码已读

selected_success_code.caveat: 这是当前1.0.1选定源码；不是NAV最大连通面积，也没有在该成功谓词内直接检查SPL或无碰撞。episode其它终止/碰撞统计本轮未核。

selected_success_code.name: PickPlaceCounterToCabinet
selected_success_code.definition: object_inside_cabinet AND gripper_obj_far；不仅对象目标XY距离。

sources.read_level: 一手；选定正文/源码已读

entries.name: GRUtopia / GRScenes (current InternUtopia)
entries.title: GRUtopia: Dream General Robots in a City at Scale

navigation.embodiment: UnitreeH1 RGB-D humanoid; explicit locomotion/fall-reset control.
navigation.boundary: Paper locomotion uses explicit fall/reset mechanism; navigation success without reset statistics can hide physical failures.

manipulation.task: AlienGo mobile base + UnitreeZ1 arm picks handheld object and places in target receptacle satisfying up to2conditions; multiple valid placements allowed.
manipulation.reported_result: Paper§4.4 reports Loco-Manipulation SR=0 for studied baselines, with collision/locomotion/planning failures; existence of evaluation is not proof reliable manipulation.
manipulation.extra_control_experiment: PaperTable3 separately compares flat vs furnished environments and reports manipulation controller success drop100%->8%; distinct from end-to-endGRBench0%.
manipulation.boundary: Do not merge controller and full-task results or call scene loading successful manipulation.

evaluation.dataset_caveat: Paper claims100k scene prototypes across89categories. Current official released GRScenes data card states99environments (69home+30commercial). Do not claim100kpublic downloadable full scenes.

selected_code.observed: Current platform links separate InternNav and InternManip benchmark documentation.
Pinned README requires IsaacSim4.5.0 and NVIDIA runtime.
Actual current distance metric calc implementation.
Current manipulation task delegates episode finish and configured metric calculation; this is not a complete paper SR/SCR evaluator by itself.

official_code.boundary: Complete current platform tree and selected tiny task/metric files checked. Current README delegates benchmarks to InternNav/InternManip; their complete evaluators and exact correspondence to2024paper runs were not audited. Do not assert full original benchmark reproduction.

cross_entry_findings.genuine_task_to_layout: STABLE 以 task instruction 生成桌面布局；SceneSmith 以 task 生成 scene prompts 再生成开放清单场景；RoomWright 从 room brief 推断用途并扩展组成。三者均不同于固定空壳与完整不可变 IDs。
cross_entry_findings.image_to_task: Scene2Demo 先重建图像场景，再生成/执行 query 对应任务；其 BC 成功不能描述为纯 task→room layout 生成。
cross_entry_findings.evaluation_not_generation: SceneTeract 验证 scene+agent+task；RoboCasa365/GRUtopia 提供实际机器人任务和既有环境，不是同协议自由布局生成器。
cross_entry_findings.physical_vs_execution: OC、AwT/AwS、SceneEval NAV/ACC、verifier plan pass、交互计数、模拟器加载均不等于执行 policy SR；已报告 rollout 的工作也有不同控制器和协议。
cross_entry_findings.task2_names: 本次未确认 Task2Scene/Task2Room 的准确一手文献身份，不作为已存在方法引用。
cross_entry_findings.remaining_combination: 本次条目未证明同时覆盖：固定观测空壳/门窗、完整不可变 IDs、无 GT mesh 的未知尺寸、共享 RoomGen 实现，以及同预算导航/操作 policy SR。这是本次证据选择中的缺口，不是全球首创证明。

recommended_evaluation_contract: 在完整清单之外冻结明确目标、任务必需物/affordance 和非目标初始状态；缺必需物时报告不适用，不静默补物。
分别报告全请求资产/装配有效率和全预定 episode 的任务 SR；仅在有效装配上的 conditional SR 是诊断。
所有布局方法共享机器人尺寸、夹爪、资产 fit、物性、控制器、起终点、horizon、seed 和预算；不得未披露地缩小对象或机器人使任务变易。
SceneTeract 式可行性是中间层；真实任务端点需冻结 policy 和成功谓词后执行。
区分 task/object/layout/style 未见与真实世界迁移；Scene2Demo 两个 BC 任务、SceneTeract ScanNet 判断迁移都比一般 robot transfer 更窄。
保留胜出的 GPT one-shot，采用同资产/task backend 与修复预算。
记录生成、装配、物性、导入、goal 构造、未知支撑和 timeout 失败，禁止幸存样本排行。
统计按 house/source 聚类；同房间的资产与 policy seeds 属嵌套重复。Scene2Demo 长程重复 demos 不是独立房间。
archive_note: Original source-cache paths are ephemeral receipts, not archived dependencies. Public URLs and pinned commits are the replay references. Paper PDF/HTML full texts and model assets are excluded.
